## Summary

Fitting an HMM favors likely transitions, so its states last longer than k-means types.
A non-homogeneous HMM lets a climate index change the transition matrix.

For more notes, read:

- @greene_nhmm:2011 §5.1, pp. 350-351, on the non-homogeneous hidden Markov model and its long-run state probabilities.
